page_note: Page is overwhelmingly substrate eschatological cosmology — the cosmos-as-prison teaching with explicit enumeration ('The Third is...', 'The Fourth is the release'), the 1468-year great-fire interval, the Last Extraction (ⲁⲡⲁⲛⲁⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ), Light ascending to reign, Darkness bound in chain/tomb, the five works. Heavy physical damage (91.7%) but every surviving teaching unit maps cosmos→cosmos. The only editorial seam is the page's last line (i=35), where after the cosmic process closes the text pivots to 'the elect and the teachers' speaking/proclaiming — institutional pair extension. Two effectively null lines (i=10, i=16) are pure lacuna placeholders.
